title: ETHMatch
tagline: Secure crypto-native dating app with Tea-styled communication, by Walrus storage, and WorldID.
description:
This project aims to satisfy the gap between traditional dating apps where you don't know whom you going to met. Have you ever thought, what their exes have been ? or what they had faced ?
Now, this app allows you do just that. The famous Tea app allowed women's to share their opinions however it was short lived and leaked thousands of verification documents online.
This should never happen to users. 
That's why we utilized World's verification system through WorldID, utilized walrus as our database. Created in-memory graph database with onchain storage capability within walrus.
how_its_made: Technologies Used: World minikit is used to scaffold a mini app on world, , Nextjs, typescript, express for backend, tailwindcss for styling, builder.io for quick prototyping, "walgraph-frontend" (built on sui-basecamp: https://wal-graph-frontend.vercel.app/ ) for graph database structure.
